hooks.command: if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ .planning/memory/.*\.json$ ]]; then python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('$FILE_PATH'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: Invalid JSON in memory file'; fi
if [[ "$COMMAND" =~ python3.*\.py ]]; then python3 --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'Python3 not available'; fi
